chapter.verse: Tu-in Kha in kiteltak a genin ah, sehtuam hun a tawp lam ciangin mi kimkhat in upna taisanin zuauthei khate leh dawi vai thuhilhnate pom ding uh hi.
A tuaci hih uh pen a kitheihtawmna lungsim uh a kihalkang, zuauphuakte' puatham kineihna hang ahi hi.
Tua mite in nupa kitenna kham uh a, tua banah thumaan thutak a um a thei mite' zat dinga Pasian' piansak, hehpih phatna tawh nek ding ahi ante, kidek ding zong kisamsak lai uh hi.
A hang pen Pasian' piansak khempeuh a hoih hi a, hehpih phatna tawh a kisang ahih nakleh nolh ding khat zong om lo hi.
Tua nate pen Pasian' thu leh thungetna tawh a siang ahi hi.
Hih thute sanggamte' mai-ah na lahkhiat nakleh na zuihsa ahi upna thu leh thuhilhna hoih tawh a hong kikhansuah Khris Jesu' nasem hoih na hiding hi.
Ahi zongin a biaknavailo, a haivai, khanglui tuanthute peel inla biakna lungsim a khan nading na kisinzaw in.
A hang pen pumpi sekna ah phattuamna tawm bang om teei ahih hangin biakna lungsim ahihleh tu-a nuntakna leh hong tung ding nuntakna' ading kamciam nei ahih manin phattuamna namkim om hi.
Hih thugenna pen a muantaak thu, a bupin a sanhuai thu ahi hi.
A hang pen tua ding mah cihna tawh nasep hahkatin nakpi-in a nawk ka hi uh a, tua pen mi khempeuh' Honpa, a diakin a umte' Honpa ahi, a nungta Pasian' tungah lametna nei ka hih man uh ahi hi.
Hih thute thupiakin nei inla hilh in.
Na khangnona hangin kuamah ii etneu dingin om kei inla kampauna, gamtat luhekna, itna, upna leh sianthona cihte ah thu-um mite' ading etteh lim khatin om in.
Kong tun matengin mipi mai-ah Pasian' Laibu simkhiatna, hanthot hehnepna, thuhilhna cihte vaipuak na la in.
Kamsanna leh pawlpi makaipawl ii khutngak thungetna tawh na ngah hehpihna gah koihdak kei in.
Na khantohna vekpi' muhtheih ahih nadingin hih thute lungngai inla tuate tawh kidiah in.
Nangmahmah leh nangma' thuhilhna encik kidawm inla tua sungah kipsuak in. A hang pen tua bangin na hihleh nangmahmah ahi-a na thugen a ngaite ahi zongin a honkhia na hiding hi.
